sources.entry: Shifty - macOS menu bar app that gives you more control over Night Shift.

summary.one_liner: Shifty is a macOS menu bar app that extends the built-in Night Shift feature with per-app, per-website, and scheduled control.
summary.what_it_does: Shifty lets you disable Night Shift for specific apps, websites, and custom time periods. It provides quick access to a slider for fine-tuning color temperature from the menu bar. A Quick Toggle makes it easier to switch Night Shift on and off. It can also set dark mode based on a schedule. Users can assign global keyboard shortcuts to common Shifty actions. Website shifting is supported in Safari, Chrome, and Vivaldi.
use_cases: disable night shift for specific apps
turn off night shift on certain websites
schedule night shift and dark mode
toggle night shift with a keyboard shortcut
adjust Night Shift from the menu bar
notable: Per-app and per-website Night Shift exclusions
Color temperature slider in the menu bar
Global keyboard shortcuts for common actions
Scheduled dark mode alongside Night Shift
caveats: Requires macOS 10.12.4 or later and hardware that supports Night Shift
Website shifting only works with Safari, Chrome, and Vivaldi
